name: BD-MediFlora-22: A 22-Species Medicinal Plant Leaf Dataset
description: A high-resolution botanical computer vision dataset comprising 3,096 leaf images representing 22 distinct medicinal plant species native to Bangladesh, developed through collaboration between Daffodil International University and Bangladesh Agricultural University to support biodiversity classification and medicinal plant recognition.
